items.quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication. Include your API key in the `Authorization` header of every request:
items.why: Quote states API key sent as Bearer token in Authorization header.

items.quote: Authentication: OAuth 2.1 (Claude, ChatGPT) or an API key sent as a Bearer token (OpenAI Agent Builder and other clients).
items.why: Says API key as Bearer token, but for unnamed clients, not the public REST API; also mentions OAuth.

items.quote: You can start for free: new accounts get 100 free credits, no card required, and one transcript costs one credit.
items.why: States new accounts get 100 free credits with no card required.

items.quote: All API requests are made to: https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2
items.why: Gives only the base URL; endpoints, metering and Swagger are not shown.

items.quote: Yes. TranscriptAPI runs an MCP server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp.
items.why: States the vendor runs an MCP server at the given URL; official status is implied.

items.quote: Extract YouTube video transcripts with a simple API call or through Model Context Protocol
items.why: Covers transcripts and REST/MCP access; search, channel and playlist browsing are not mentioned.
